wireContracts.name: Numeric envelope
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: format=mdemat.numericRecord, explicit supported v1 only; optional producer retained, exact envelope fieldset; arrays present only JSON; reject unsupported schema before payload decode.

wireContracts.name: Reader info
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Producer may be absent in old v1 and is reported as empty char; reader schema is codec-supported v1, not metadata-auto-upgraded.

wireContracts.name: Array/char tree nodes
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Closed node shape; kind=array/char; variable n+digits exists; char points to uint16 UTF-16 numeric array; reference-only loading.

wireContracts.name: String tree nodes
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: missing is per-element mask, never scalar-only. Strict 0/1 or logical representation, correct element count; preserve Unicode/missing, scalar empty strings, strings(0,3)/(2,0).

wireContracts.name: Cell/struct tree nodes
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Closed fieldsets, unique valid struct field names, child count matches element/field products; dimension/node/depth/container budgets before rebuilding, including giant zero-field struct.

wireContracts.name: JSON primitive payload
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Whitelisted exact types/byte widths; little-endian base64; scalar sparse/complex flags; exact independent real/imag byte lengths before decode/complex; sparse unique in-range indices and CSC column memory budget; logical payload bytes 0/1.

wireContracts.name: MAT container variables
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: uint8 UTF-8 manifest; whos preflight primitive-only class/size/sparse/complex; bounded manifest before reference-only load. MAT v7 >=2GiB variables refused before save; temporary inventory/class/shape/complex/sparse checked before scoped NIO commit.

wireContracts.name: RunRecord top-level
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Explicit v1 writer guard; pure value structs; no State/Config validators/observers/table serialization; mutable record revalidated when written; successful execution is not accuracy.

wireContracts.name: Validation report
wireContracts.owner: caller assessor supplies evidence; factory checks schema
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Exact six fields, scalar text/struct contracts, PASS/FAIL require supplied nonempty evidence, default UNVERIFIED. Factory does not infer physical truth from arbitrary measurement/bound names.

wireContracts.name: Provenance
wireContracts.owner: caller supplies provenance; factory validates shape/format
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: UTC exact UTC text format/date, explicit integer seed range or empty, codeVersion explicit. No automatic clock/Git/RNG capture or product/license inference.

wireContracts.name: State v1 value schema
wireContracts.owner: data.variable shared State schema and explicit State subclasses
wireContracts.compatibility: Existing valid v1 keys/values/layouts retained; stricter checks reject damaged descriptions only.
wireContracts.newChecks: Keys/format=mdemat.state/schemaVersion=1 unchanged. Generic numeric data checked separately from explicit callback binding; each State owner checks kind/spaces/parameters/DOF packing. No saved class name chooses constructors.

wireContracts.name: Completed-step envelope
wireContracts.compatibility: Envelope field names retained; readCheckpoint reads v1 and intentional new inner schema v2. Source API changes separately documented; existing v1 files stay readable, never rewritten.
wireContracts.newChecks: Explicit execution extraction replaces old tools wrapper. State.load handles State only. Resume validates model/ODE workspace before mutation; automatic accepted-step names owned by execution.

wireContracts.name: Checkpoint configuration identity
wireContracts.compatibility: Intentional inner schema v2 extension, not a silent edit to v1; execution reads/projects v1 in memory before comparing new descriptors.
wireContracts.newChecks: Resolved model values only, observer keys excluded; v1 omitted top callbacks normalized to explicit placeholders. v2 adds schemaVersion=2 and nested callback paths/placeholders. Compare only projected model identity; names cannot prove callback implementation equality.

wireContracts.name: Assessment observation and summary values
wireContracts.owner: execution assessment and tools.analyze ordinary values
wireContracts.compatibility: Ordinary observation/summary fields only; the primitive numeric-record transport schema remains v1. Existing numeric selections may omit ResolvedComponentIds; they resolve to the same ordered numeric selection.
wireContracts.newChecks: ComponentIds='all' is permitted only for sequence and requires explicit complete ordered ResolvedComponentIds=1:N; the all selection identity stays fixed as N grows. Summary preserves each level's resolved IDs as an nLevels-by-1 cell. Fixed numeric selections preserve their order and cannot claim different resolved IDs.

wireContracts.name: Execution convergence table identity
wireContracts.compatibility: Execution table return values and metadata only; no new primitive transport type or schema bump. Norms with the same non-spatial-norm identity share one table, with the spatial norm represented explicitly in column names.
wireContracts.newChecks: Every level keeps its actual component count and resolved IDs; table UserData retains original grouping field/reference/component identities. Bounded valid unique keys are presentation labels, so long names and ambiguous concatenations cannot merge distinct identities. Norm columns require matching scales and resolved selections.

additionalReadLimits.policy: Adjustable finite positive integer limits; no claim parser is zero-allocation or complete memory isolation.

evidenceBoundary: Exact source/interface coverage and live test references are structural reconciliation; acceptance remains separate native full-suite/build/install evidence.

focusedNativeEvidence.scope: TestAnalysis and TestModeConvergence only; final all-suite gates remain separate
